lastResponse.text: Most important first: if you feel you might act on these thoughts, call nine one one now. If you can stay safe for this minute, call two one one right now and say: “I’m alone in Portland, no sleep for two days, and I need a live crisis specialist now.” If this phone dies, ask the nearest person immediately to call two one one for you.
originalTexts: Most important first: if you feel you might act on these thoughts, call **911** now. If you can stay safe for this minute, call **211** right now and say: “I’m alone in Portland, no sleep for two days, and I need a live crisis specialist now.” If this phone dies, ask the nearest person immediately to call **211** for you.
